newsitem.title: UK: STV said close to bid for Grampian.
newsitem.headline: STV said close to bid for Grampian.

text.p: Scottish Media Group Plc, the owner of Scottish Television, is about to clinch a 105 million pounds ($170 million) agreed bid for Grampian Television Plc, the Sunday Times newspaper said.
It said Scottish Media was thought to be offering as much as 325 pence per share, compared with Grampian's closing price on Friday of 265 pence.
If the bid went ahead, Scottish Media would become the most influential media group in Scotland, the paper said. It was not immediately possible to contact Scottish Media for comment.
